levels.surface: إبراهيم بن عبد الله بن حنين

notes: needs ruling: from «فأرسلني ابن عباس إلى أبي أيوب» the report is a first-person narrative whose speaker (the messenger) is not named; Abu Ayyub speaks inside it («وقال هكذا رأيت رسول الله»), and the rules do not settle whether he is a link after that speaker
chain read as written up to the two Companions («عن عبد الله بن عباس، والمسور بن مخرمة»): they are one level; the story after them is not added
«أبيه» has no name here: a relation link, not identified
